High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:8067
Court No. - 92
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 43990 of 2023

Applicant :- Babloo Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ashutosh Tripathi, advocate holding brief of Sri Akhilesh Tripathi, counsel for the
applicant and Sri P.C. Srivastava, learned Additional Advocate General for the State and perused the
record.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking quashing of the order dated 15-09-2023 whereby non-bailable warrants have been issued against the applicant as well as entire proceedings of Case Crime No. 756 of 2023, under Sections 306, 506, 420 and 120-B IPC, P.S. Chakeri, district Kanpur Nagar.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that, a suicide was committed by the informant's husband and the F.I.R. was lodged on the very next day with an allegation that no adequate consideration for the sale of valuable land was given, which forced the husband of the informant to commit suicide.
The police personnel after inquiring into the matter moved an application to Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Kanpur for the arrest of the accused and the same was granted.
Thereafter warrants were issued against the applicant.

The applicant has challenged the order dated Babloo Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72316801/
1 15-09-2023 whereby the court below has passed an order issuing a non-bailable warrant against the applicant.

entities.text: Babloo Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that the learned Magistrate has no power to issue non-bailable warrant under Section 73 Cr.P.C. during investigation.

4. Per contra, Sri P.C. Srivastava, learned Additional Advocate General appearing on behalf of the State submits that since the accused persons who were responsible for the crime is not joining the investigation, the Investigating Officer has no other alternative but to move to a court for issuance of a non-bailable warrant.

He further submits that in spite of the order of non-bailable warrant issued,
for the last four months he has not been traceable and neither joining the investigation, he has filed the instant application for quashing of the order issuing the non-bailable warrant.
He further submits that the co-accused is a powerful politician.
In the suicide note the name of the applicant along with other co-accused was mentioned.
It was thereafter the present proceeding was initiated and the accused had been on run, so the investigation could not be completed.

He further submits that the accused people who had forced the informant's husband to commit suicide are very powerful politically and financially, and in spite of the court's order they have been avoiding the arrest.
5.

Counsel for the applicant has placed reliance on the orders passed in the 482 Application No.
41268 of 2023 (Dr. Priya Ranjan Anshu Diwakar Vs. State of U.P. and another), wherein the same impugned order was challenged by some other co-accused.

entities.text: Priya Ranjan Anshu Diwakar Vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that during the course of the argument, the matter was put up for next day and till then order for no coercive steps was passed.
The matter was adjourned couple of more times and the interim order was extended.

Taking advantage of this situation, the co-accused filed an interim order before the Magistrate and the Magistrate under the impression that the proceeding has been stayed, has withdrawn the order dated 15-09-2023 issuing non-bailable warrant against the co-accused.
The co-accused is still on the run and has filed anticipatory bail.
He is also not joining the investigation.
6. Apparently, it seems that the entire efforts of the applicant is just to stall the proceedings and not to be arrested or join the investigation.
Even four months have been passed by, both the accused are not joining the investigation.
This is a shocking state of affairs.
This Court finds no merit in the instant application and is accordingly dismissed.

Order Date :- 17.1.2024 pks  Babloo Yadav vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72316801/
